required_recovery: Only matching algorithm on uniform synthetic sine/box, normalized and linear_detrended; published BLS normalized and linear_detrended. All other recovery and false-positive outcomes are diagnostics and retained.
constant_policy: Zero-variance period search may reject with typed error or return finite candidates; neither is evidence of a detection.
reference_policy: LS direct weighted sine/cosine/intercept least squares at returned best frequency; allow fast-grid approximation within 0.01 absolute normalized power. BLS exhaustive phase-window weighted two-level regression at returned period and duration gives an upper bound on achievable positive depth SNR, not an independent global period oracle.
false_positive_policy: Count threshold flags on 10 fixed white and 10 fixed AR(1) red nulls separately by algorithm and stage; report denominator and Wilson interval. No false-positive-rate or FAP calibration acceptance threshold.
sampling_and_preprocessing: Archive selection and synthetic truth fixed before search. Compare identical search settings before/after preprocessing. No tuning to preserve recoveries.
